names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 martie, «Sfântul Mucenic Talu».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Τρόφιμος και Θαλλός που μαρτύρησαν στη Λαοδικεία», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's third heading for the Julian 16 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свештеномученик Трофин и Тал.“, with the rank word Свештеномученик left off, which stands at the head of the pair. The heading gives no city, so the bare forename is what the source gives.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 martie — «Sfântul Mucenic Talu»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Τρόφιμος και Θαλλός που μαρτύρησαν στη Λαοδικεία»

attestations.note: The page puts them under Diocletian «(284 - 305 μ.Χ.)» and makes them natives of Stratonike or Stratonikeia in the province of Caria in Asia Minor, «και σήμερα τούρκικα ονομάζεται Αϊδενελλί»; the governor of Laodicea who first freed them and then had them crucified is named Asklepios, and the relics were carried home to Stratonike by two countrymen, Zosimos and Artemios, and laid a mile outside the city at a place called Latomeia. It prints no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 29.03.2026 (16. март ст. ст.) — „Свештеномученик Трофин и Тал.“

attestations.note: The day's third and last entry, an enumerated company of two, so two rows; this is the second of the two names. Read as this pair: brothers born in Syria, stoned — and the stones turned back on the throwers — then both crucified, teaching from their crosses, which is the story saint.gr already tells of the Trophimus and Thallus martyred at Laodicea and whose Greek and Romanian rows this folder carries on 11 March. The Prologue puts their passion „у граду Вофору“, in a city Вофор, where saint.gr puts it at Laodicea; the two cities were not reconciled and the Prologue names no Laodicea. Its 300 falls inside the reign of Diocletian this folder already holds, so no date was touched. The stored form is the bare forename: Свештеномученик heads the pair and the heading gives neither brother a city. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: saint.gr: «Οι Άγιοι αυτοί μαρτύρησαν στα χρόνια του Διοκλητιανού (284 - 305 μ.Χ.)». The page gives no year, so the interval is the reign it prints.
